text: Bug fix: Import errors now show each distinct message once instead of repeating it.
Feature: The Position Board map picker lists every available map and marks maps that still need an image as placeholders.
Feature: A draft or comp can now use several maps or a whole game mode.

Feature: Cradle: Krakoa (Domination), Central Park, Hall of Djalia, Heart of Heaven, Lower Manhattan, Shin-Shibuya and Symbiotic Surface (Convergence), and Arakko, Midtown, Thebes, Yggdrasill Path and Spider-Islands (Convoy) are now available as Position Board maps.
